name: flow-key-parse-once
title: F4 flow keys and parsing: interned adapter slot, parse-once view, atomic sequence trackers
description: Structural finding F4 of 09-29-tcp-udp-path-structural-perf: FlowKey is 100+ bytes with a string adapter id compared on every dictionary probe, the same frame is parsed four times per redirected packet (processor classify, IsTcpSyn, sequence observation, checksum revalidation), and the TCP redirect association's two uint? sequence trackers cost two lock entries per packet. Measured baseline: the IPv6 reverse forwarded leg is a reproducible 2.0x the IPv4 leg.
